name: lookup_booking
description: Look up a booking by its PNR. Call this FIRST, before any other action.

name: issue_refund
description: Issue a refund for a booking. Only call after eligibility is confirmed; for amounts over $500, only after escalate_to_manager has returned approved=true.

name: escalate_to_manager
description: Escalate to a human manager for approval. Required for refunds over $500 and for any out-of-policy request.
